items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: We didn't have any, Nancy. No more collars.

ctx.x: I know it has rice, but that's all I know. It's rice.

Overnight. And has to… I don't know really how it's made, but the lady told me. It's made overnight and it has to rise. And the next day, then you add some more flour or something to it. And make a batter of it. And it drops it like you drop… not pancakes, but anyhow, it drops in hot, hot lord. And it makes a little round thing. And this is collars. And we couldn't sell enough of them. The people who was in collars… We want collars… call them all kinds of names. We want collars. We want everything. Oh, we…
I think I might can find you the recipe. You think so?
